runtimeObservations.scope: Current user-driven iOS simulator debug app, 12 one-second RSS snapshots; not a controlled voice benchmark, lifetime peak, physical-device RAM limit or release measurement. Same offline inference stack, observed before refreshing the simulator with the route removal.
runtimeObservations.refreshedSnapshotScope: Updated offline-only debug build just after simulator launch; no controlled inference workload.
runtimeObservations.nativeSnapshotScope: One RSS sample during native automatic-advance replay verification before the prepared-acknowledgement optimisation with the same Whistle/Needle/Kokoro stack: 1,218,208 KiB. Not a lifetime peak or physical-device release measurement.

provisionalPlanning.ios: iOS 18+; target iPhone 13 / A15 or newer

limits: No physical-device peak RAM, thermals, battery endurance or latency qualification.
Android installed storage includes OS-managed data and is not the same as ZIP contents.

Model updates, retained old packages, encrypted reports and evidence add variable storage.
